summary: Rough introductory notes arguing that network graphics protocols proposed so far are not general enough. They need to handle attention handling, picture structure and other high-level interactive graphics processes, so they can operate sophisticated systems.

eli5.summary: A person reads the plans for a picture system and says they are missing important things, like picture structure and how to respond when someone points.

questions: what must a network graphics protocol consider
why were early graphics protocols too limited
